title: rConfig Core 8.2.19 before 8.2.22 contains a server-side request forgery vulnerability that allows authenticated users…
description: rConfig Core versions 8.2.19 through 8.2.21 contain a server-side request forgery (SSRF) vulnerability that allows authenticated users to bypass loopback IP validation by supplying unresolved hostnames. This can lead to remote code execution via Redis inline commands during configuration downloads.
